desc: Implement smaller-side combination enumeration: if K <= N-K, iterate all K-combinations of indices computing XOR and track max; if K > N-K, precompute total XOR T, iterate all (N-K)-combinations of excluded indices and take max of T XOR excluded-XOR. Treat duplicate values as distinct indices. Handle S==0 (K==N) by printing T. Keep memory bounded by streaming the max.
Verify against sample inputs: Sample 1 (4 2 / 3 2 6 4) -> 7, Sample 2 (10 4 / ...) -> 2024. Also edge cases K=1, K=N, and S up to 11.
Confirm complement identity: max over K-subsets of XOR = max over excluded (N-K)-subsets of (T XOR excluded-XOR), with T = total XOR.
